title: From Radio Shack to The Shack
label: Brand gallery
lede: The brand went from a red block-letter sign to a circle-R and one-word wordmark in the 1990s, an orange-red refresh by 2014, and a nickname campaign in 2009. These are the marks as they appeared in archived pages, and our drawings of the products and stores that made the name.

archive.caption: The circle-R and wordmark on the first website.

The last refresh, three months before Chapter 11.
